title: Flaky test: coder-new delegation_events channel_rejects_wrong_tokens_and_closes_unfinished_redacted_children
body: Fails about one run in three locally: `crates/coder-new/src/delegation_events.rs:433` assertion left 0, right 2. Seen 2026-10-09 on main (6375bb2cab and later) while integrating #11045–#11048; passes on rerun. Likely a timing race in the test's channel setup.
